description:
List the WhatsApp inboxes the calling 360dialog user can access.

Call this first when you don't know which `channel_id` to pass to the
other tools: each entry pairs a `channel_id` with its inbox URL and
WhatsApp number (`wa_id`). Entries without a `channel_id` cannot be
driven through these tools.

The listing covers the caller's own client accounts, plus every inbox under
a partner the caller administers. It never reaches another tenant: a client
user is not shown other clients' inboxes, including ones managed by the same
partner. An empty list does not mean no inbox exists; pass a known
`channel_id` to the other tools directly.
name: getchat_list_inboxes
title: List inboxes
